items.title: Marty Sheller interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 9, 2022
items.q: And somehow Jon Hendricks wrote lyrics to my solo that I played on that.

ctx.x: Well it sure does stick in your head, I’ll say that much.

Yeah. Yeah. When you mentioned Jon Hendricks, that brings a story to mind again about Mongo. I had written a song called “Cuidado” which means be careful, and it was an uptempo mambo, a jazz mambo, written basically on bebop kind of chords. And Mongo was with Columbia at that time. And somehow Jon Hendricks wrote lyrics to my solo that I played on that. And we were going into the studio to record so Mongo said, “Hey Jon, come to the studio and record that, it sounds great. It’ll be a great selling point.” So he…
